```plato

    // One beam load resolved into the degrees of freedom it acts on: a point
    // force onto the deflection of the nearest node, a moment onto that node's
    // rotation, and a distributed force onto the four degrees of freedom of every
    // element it covers.
    LoadContributions(load: BeamLoad, b: Beam, elementCount: Integer): Array<DofLoad>
        => match (load)
        {
            PointForce(position, magnitude) =>
                [DofLoad(DofIndex(b.BeamNearestNode(elementCount, position) * 2), magnitude)];
            DistributedForce(start, end, magnitude) =>
                b.BeamDistributedContributions(elementCount, start, end, magnitude);
            Moment(position, magnitude) =>
                [DofLoad(DofIndex(b.BeamNearestNode(elementCount, position) * 2 + 1), magnitude)];
        };

    // The load vector of the discretised beam.
    BeamLoadVector(b: Beam, elementCount: Integer): Array<Number>
        => b.Loads.FlatMap(load => load.LoadContributions(b, elementCount))
            .ScatterLoads((elementCount + 1) * 2);

    // The transverse analysis of a beam discretised into `elementCount` uniform
    // elements: assemble, load, restrain, solve, and split the solution vector
    // into the deflection and rotation at each node.
    SolveBeam(b: Beam, elementCount: Integer, settings: LinearSolveSettings): BeamSolution
    {
        var dofCount = (elementCount + 1) * 2;
        var stiffness = SparseMatrix(dofCount, dofCount, b.BeamStiffnessEntries(elementCount));
        var solved = stiffness.SolveConstrained(b.BeamLoadVector(elementCount),
            b.BeamConstraints(elementCount), settings);
        var u = solved.Solution;
        return BeamSolution(
            b.BeamNodePositions(elementCount),
            (elementCount + 1).MapRange(i => u[i * 2]),
            (elementCount + 1).MapRange(i => u[i * 2 + 1]),
            solved.Iterations, solved.Residual, solved.Converged);
    }

    // The largest deflection anywhere along the discretised beam, in meters — the
    // one number a serviceability check compares against a span-over-N limit.
    MaximumDeflection(solution: BeamSolution): Number
        => solution.Deflections.Reduce(0.0, (worst, d) => d.Abs.Max(worst));
}
```
